visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a split screen showing a colorful seafood salad with shrimp and a man wearing a black-and-white checkered shirt sitting in a restaurant. The man holds chopsticks and smiles at the camera. The background is a brightly lit indoor restaurant with yellow walls and wooden decor. (2) Close-up shots of various Thai dishes follow, including stir-fried water spinach with garlic in a brown sauce and a plate of golden-brown shrimp cakes arranged in a circle around a small bowl of dipping sauce. The lighting is warm and highlights the textures of the food. (3) The man is shown eating a spoonful of green curry mixed with white rice. He closes his eyes and nods, expressing satisfaction. Behind him, other diners are visible in a blurred background, and a chef in a black t-shirt with a Thai flag logo works in the kitchen area. (4) A close-up of a silver rice pot is shown as a spoon scoops out steamed white rice. The man then takes a large bite of a thick, fried shrimp cake, dipping it in sauce first. Yellow text overlays appear periodically at the center and bottom of the frame. (5) The man is seen mixing a pot of shrimp vermicelli with a fork, lifting a large portion of the glass noodles. The video concludes with the man eating while a large graphic overlay displays the restaurant's address and contact information over the lower half of the screen.
